definitions.explanation: Indicating that a product was manufactured in Japan. Often used as a quality marker, since 'Made in Japan' has strong positive connotations both domestically and abroad.

examples.japanese: {日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本製|にほんせい}だ。
examples.english: This watch is made in Japan.

examples.japanese: {日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese-made home appliances are highly regarded for their quality.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (Japan) + the suffix ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made in/of). The ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ suffix attaches to country or material names to indicate origin or composition: ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}{製|せい}→中国製：28456_chuugokusei⟧ (made in China), ⟦{金属|きんぞく}{製|せい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧ (made of metal).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a noun modifier: {日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun ({日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧)
- As a predicate: {日本製|にほんせい}だ / です

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧: a Japanese-made car
- {日本製|にほんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧: Japanese-made appliances
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{日本製|にほんせい}: purely Japanese-made (all components made in Japan)
